_comment: Cell descriptor for layout/bin/compose-cell.py (issues #46, #121). See
layout/opamp_stage1/README.md for the floorplan, matching style and results.
SCOPE: the first-stage sub-block of design/netlist/opamp_core.spice:
XM1/XM2  nfet_01v8 W=6.03 L=1.2 (input pair, issue #46)
XM3/XM4  pfet_01v8 W=4.635 L=0.3 (mirror, issue #121, grid-legal width of DR-013)
Not the full op-amp (README 'Scope').
NMOS PAIR: klt diff_pair, splits=2 -> 2x2 common-centroid cross-quad, each device
two 3.015 um units (2 x 3.015 = 6.03). snap_ports_to_grid_um moves each port attach
point <= 0.0025 um (klayout-tools#2932). fe_masks is a klt-draw overlay adding the
nsdm/psdm/npc/poly-endcap masks the sky130 generators do not draw (#2934, #2936).
PMOS MIRROR (block mp34, a klt-draw block with explicit ports): a 2 x 3 checkerboard
of six 1.545 um units, three per device (3 x 1.545 = 4.635, DR-013 grid-legal split;
two 2.3175 um units would be off-grid). Row 0 = XM3 | XM4 | XM3, row 1 = XM4 | XM3 | XM4
(Q1 = XM3 diode device, Q2 = XM4). It is drawn here, not by klt gen, because the
generator's gate landing pad (0.42 um) is wider than a L=0.3 gate and abuts the
diffusion, which Magic's poly.4 rejects (24 sites); mp34 keeps the generator's
geometry but starts the pad 0.15 um clear of the diffusion. It also carries the
psdm/nsdm/npc masks, the 0.15 um poly endcaps and an nwell 0.2 um beyond the n-tap
ring (the generator's 0.15 um fails diff/tap.10).
ROUTING PLANES (one net family per plane where nets must cross):
metal  (li1)  vss  -- NMOS TAP_W west to its pin stub
metal2 (met1) tail -- NMOS source columns, joined at y=-2.0
metal2 (met1) vdd  -- PMOS source columns (one strap per column through both
rows), row-0 sources joined at y=-2.0, ring tap TAP_E via x=20
metal3 (met2) d1   -- NMOS XM1 drains (south/east loop) into the PMOS gate bus
(row buses y=2.155 / y=4.92, east trunk x=18.55) and the
XM3 drains; also inn (west/north loop)
metal4 (met3) d2   -- NMOS XM2 drains (y=11.0) to the east pin, with a branch
down x=9.0 to the XM4 drain bus at y=2.5; also inp (west)
The PMOS S and D pads sit 0.72 um apart, closer than met3.space.1 allows two
nets' met3 pads, so vdd stays on met1 and only d2 reaches met3 in the mirror.
PINS: boundary nets end on klt-draw stubs (west: tail, inn, vss, inp; east: d1, d2,
vdd) whose PAD is promoted via pins[].
